name: working-hour
title: Working Hour
description: 查询和统计 iTalent 平台的工作时长数据
author: meunicorn

commands.name: quick-view-working-hour
commands.title: 快速查看工时
commands.subtitle: Working Hour
commands.description: 快速查看当前考勤周期的工时统计（HUD 显示）

commands.name: get-working-hour
commands.title: 查看工时详情
commands.subtitle: Working Hour
commands.description: 查看详细的工时统计信息，包括平均工时、目标差异和迟到次数

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: 工时菜单栏
commands.subtitle: Working Hour
commands.description: 在顶部菜单栏显示今日工时和快速操作

preferences.name: password
preferences.title: 登录密码
preferences.description: iTalent 登录密码（插件会自动使用 RSA 加密）

preferences.name: userText
preferences.title: 用户信息
preferences.description: 格式：姓名(邮箱)，例如：张三(zhangsan@company.com)

preferences.name: uid
preferences.title: 用户 UID
preferences.description: 登录网页版后，地址栏中的 xpuid 参数值

preferences.name: targetHour
preferences.title: 目标工时
preferences.description: 每天的目标工作时长（小时），默认 9.5

preferences.name: refreshInterval
preferences.title: 自动刷新频率
preferences.description: 菜单栏数据的自动刷新间隔时间

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
